nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=30 beats='first holiday morning; Miri unlatches the school coop with the brass hook and scoops corn from the tin; Clover and Butter hurry out; the low perch where little Pip sleeps is bare'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=38 beats='Miri counts beaks twice and only gets two; her tummy flips; the back of the coop is shadowy and smells of warm straw; across the yard the gate latch hangs open a crack; two places a small hen could be'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=28 beats='Miri tiptoes into the dim coop; dust floats in a sunbeam; she holds her breath and listens hard for any small scratch or peep'>>

choices.label: Look closely at the empty nest

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=40 beats='one warm brown egg sits in the empty nest; a loose board wobbles; tiny three-toed footprints cross the dusty floor toward the pophole; behind the nesting boxes a knothole in the wall holds a snag of pale fluff'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=28 beats='a dusty corner behind the boxes; the knothole is just hen-sized and pale fluff waves on a splinter; outside the big hedge presses right against the coop wall'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=40 beats='a cool green tunnel inside the hedge; white fluff on the thorns; in a leafy hollow sits Pip, fluffed up big on a scooped nest of dry leaves; she is sitting on something small and round and will not budge'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=28 beats='the little prints march out the pophole and across the yard; a thin line of spilled seed joins them; both lead straight to the tool shed door standing ajar'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=40 beats='the shed smells of earth and string; the seed sack has toppled and spilled; one seed line dribbles behind the stacked watering cans where something goes peep; another trickles out through a low knothole toward the field'>>

choices.label: Follow the seed to the field

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=28 beats='the biggest watering can lies on its side and rocks all by itself; a muffled peep echoes inside the tin; seed dust speckles the spout'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=40 beats='the can tips and out blinks Pip, dusty grey all over with seed stuck to her beak; she is wedged snug in the tin and looks quite cross; her little feet paddle the air'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=28 beats='the seed trail crosses the field edge; seed husks scatter at the mouth of an old rabbit burrow under the fence; a soft rustle sounds deep inside'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=40 beats='the burrow mouth is dark and just hen-sized; Miri hears scratching and one small peep; a nettle patch crowds one side of the hole; her pocket still holds a handful of corn from the tin'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=28 beats='the gate latch hangs open just a crack, wide enough for a small hen; a smudge of pale fluff clings to the gatepost; the lane outside is quiet'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=40 beats='a narrow lane runs between hedge and fence; next door Mr. Okafor waters his beans while his dog Biscuit sniffs the ground; the other way, little white feathers dot the path that slopes down toward the creek'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=20 beats='Mr. Okafor saw a small brown hen scoot past his beans at sunrise; Biscuit whines and pulls toward the compost bin'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=20 beats='Biscuit trots straight to the big compost bin; the lid sits crooked; inside something scratches and scratches'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=28 beats='the lid comes up on dark warm compost and wriggly worms; in the middle stands Pip, wings dusty, deep in a worm feast; she squawks, very surprised to be found'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=20 beats='white feathers every few steps like breadcrumbs; the path slopes down past the old oak toward the shining creek'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=20 beats='the old oak stands on roots like giant knuckles; one white feather is stuck to the bark; a peep floats up from the water below'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=28 beats='Pip preens on the flat middle stepping stone while the creek burbles around her; the stones shine with slippery wet moss; she has not seen Miri yet'>>

choices.label: Call her softly from the bank

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=68 beats='under the warm wing of Pip sits one small perfect egg; the littlest hen made herself a secret nest; Miri carries hen and egg home cupped in her jumper; she builds Pip a snug nesting box of her very own; Pip settles in like a queen; mystery solved before breakfast'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='Miri lifts Pip out of the hollow and holds her warm against her jumper; Clover and Butter fuss a loud welcome at the coop door; Pip hops onto her own perch; Miri latches the coop and checks it twice; three hens counted and safe'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='Miri scoops Pip out of the watering can and blows the seed dust off her feathers; back at the coop Pip shakes herself in a grey cloud and struts to the corn; Miri stands every can upside down so no hen can ever get stuck again'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=67 beats='Pip hops out and leads Miri on a zigzag march around the shed, along the fence, and through the whole garden before trotting into the coop by herself; girl and hen are both tired and hungry; Miri writes the whole adventure in the school hen notebook'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=68 beats='the corn trail works; Pip pokes out of the burrow and pecks her way seed by seed onto the lap of Miri; scooped up warm and safe; home before lunch with the best story ever, the hen who tried the rabbit door'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='the nettles sting her hand and Miri yelps; Pip shoots out the far side of the burrow in a puff of dust and runs home all by herself; Miri walks back rubbing her bumpy hand and finds a cool dock leaf; next time she will be patient and bring corn first'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=68 beats='Mr. Okafor walks on one side and Biscuit trots slow and proud on the other while Miri herds Pip up the lane; Clover and Butter join the line at the gate; the whole parade marches into the yard; corn for every hen and a biscuit for Biscuit'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='Pip flaps and compost flies everywhere; she scoots out of the bin, dodges Biscuit, and sprints all the way home on her own; Miri arrives puffing with compost in her hair; Pip is already on her perch looking smug; Miri learns to move slowly around hens'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=67 beats='Miri crouches low and calls in her softest voice with corn in her open hand; Pip tips her head, hops stone to stone, and steps onto the bank; they walk home along the feather path; Pip rides the last stretch tucked warm under one arm'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='the mossy stone slips and Miri sits down in the cold creek with a splash; Pip flutters calmly to the bank and struts up the path; Mr. Okafor helps Miri out; Pip is back on her perch before Miri even dries her socks; her boots take a whole day to dry'>>
